#3720: when should the manual-triage fallback fire?

The release watcher files a "manual triage needed" issue when LLM extraction fails. It decided that by asking "does the ledger contain any parse_failed entry?" and then listed every ledger version in the title. A version below the support floor is skipped by policy and keeps parse_failed: true forever, so the alarm was permanently on. Toggle entries below to compare the old gate with the fixed one.
